root_cause: Pre-pack visual-intent bindings were frozen byte-for-byte into candidate packs without validating the profile-declared minimum content-word and anchor rules. The composed audit then required both binding equality and a longer phrase, making the emitted packs impossible to satisfy. The wyvern foreleg anchor also used an instruction-shaped negative that conflicted with the positive-prompt guard.
repair: Validate every supplied visual-intent binding against the same evidence rules before candidate-pack emission.
Extend the five test visual-intent binding sets without changing their profile meaning.
Replace the wyvern negative foreleg anchor with positive wing-to-forelimb ownership geometry.
Rebuild the visual-profile index and all five immutable candidate packs, preserving the rejected packs and audits.
claim_boundary: This is a candidate-pack contract failure found before rendering, not a pixel failure.
